name: What happens during a roofing project planning consultation?

mainEntity.name: What happens during a roofing project planning consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: During a roofing project planning consultation, a Discounted Roofing Co. specialist will assess your current roof's condition, discuss your needs, and review material options. They will explain the repair or replacement process, potential timelines, and provide a detailed estimate. This initial meeting helps us understand your specific project requirements and allows you to ask questions, ensuring alignment on the scope of work before any commitment.
acceptedAnswer.description: A consultation involves a roof assessment, discussion of needs and material options, explanation of the process, and a detailed estimate to define the project scope.
